item.title: Builders lack an audience, Creators lack building skills
item.summary: I've been building products for 14 years now. I always find it funny how the world absolutely don't care when launching. No one genuinly cares for the product. At all. Never. The product never really attracts anyone. It's 100% always the storytelling about it. Even products made for engineers. You can't just test everything that looks cool on paper. And what's funny is that on the other side, there are tons of Creators now that basically do content all year long to build an audience. To end up not really knowing how to monetize it. And despite all that, I still haven't seen any big company rise from a founder duo where there's a builder and a creator. Could be nice. Or maybe just sounds good but doesn't work. Or these 2 types of people just have nowhere to meet. Thoughts? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49212245 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
